data.name: AEVUM
data.detailed_description:
AEVUM  is a 3D psychological first-person dark fantasy adventure exploring mental and physical health, fear, and escape.

After waking in Aevum, a surreal liminal space suspended between life and death, explore and unlock interconnected, mental health-inspired worlds in a bid to reach a more peaceful reality.

AEVUM: PART 1

Aevum: Part 1 (the first chapter of a larger experience) explores the beginning of this journey. Descend into the human body itself, battling manifestations of body dysmorphia, anxiety, and societal pressure, while confronting the lasting impact of mental and physical trauma within a psychological body-horror landscape

While some worlds lean towards restoration our first stage is a darker, centred on dismantling of systems and channelling femme rage as a means of catharsis.

Dark Fantasy Exploration

Explore haunting, symbolic environments inspired by inner worlds, the human body, and subconscious fears. Each space reflects emotional states through surreal architecture, lighting, and sound.

Symbolic Narrative

Themes of identity, trauma, societal pressure, fear of time, and healing the inner child are explored through visual metaphor, environment, and sensory cues.

Atmospheric Sound Design
Immersive, reactive soundscapes that guide while heightening tension, unease, and emotional intensity throughout each surreal environment.

Atmospheric Exploration

Navigate symbolic, dark fantasy spaces shaped by inner fears, trauma, transformation, rage and release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes:
Aevum contains psychological horror elements presented through symbolic and stylised visuals. It includes depictions of blood, fleshy environments, and some unsettling imagery and audio.

Player discretion is advised for those who may be affected by themes of trauma, mental health, societal pressures, body dysmorphia, misogyny, bullying, medical negligence and experiences, aging, chronic illness, disabilities, and death.
